decisions.reason: A dedicated business unit for offshore and renewable energy was announced publicly, fits the firm's stated direction toward cleaner shipping, and represents a sizeable organisational investment, so management will persist with it and treat weak results as market-cyclical.

Crew and corporate travel management builds directly on the firm's core crewing operations and has a page of its own, and its pandemic-era weakness can plausibly be attributed to temporary travel restrictions, which favours keeping it.

The online vessel information portal is part of the firm's announced digital service offering to owners, carries sunk development costs and low running costs, so it is likely retained or folded into its successors rather than withdrawn.

The mobile performance app supports the firm's sustainability and efficiency narrative and has already received development investment, so despite the risk that standalone apps get consolidated, management is inclined to justify and continue it.
